name: @echelon-foundry/typescript-wasm-kernel
description: Limen: an explicit boundary that keeps browser capabilities separate from application authority. A dependency-free browser kernel — HTTP, storage, clipboard and history as typed effects, with application state, transitions and decisions kept out of the browser entirely — plus a repository lifecycle CLI that initializes, verifies, diagnoses and upgrades that boundary.

scripts.build:site: npm run build:site:wasm && npm run test:site:fsharp && tsc -p tsconfig.site.json && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/build-site.ts
scripts.serve:site: npm run build:site && python3 -m http.server 4174 -d dist-site
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:examples && npm run build:site
scripts.test: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:docs && npm run check:site && npm run check:package && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run check && npm run build:cli:all
scripts.build:site:wasm: dotnet workload restore site/fsharp/Limen.Site.Wasm/Limen.Site.Wasm.csproj && dotnet publish site/fsharp/Limen.Site.Wasm/Limen.Site.Wasm.csproj -c Release -o site/fsharp/publish && dotnet publish site/fsharp/federation/Limen.Federation.Source.Wasm/Limen.Federation.Source.Wasm.csproj -c Release -o site/fsharp/federation/Limen.Federation.Source.Wasm/publish && dotnet publish site/fsharp/federation/Limen.Federation.Target.Wasm/Limen.Federation.Target.Wasm.csproj -c Release -o site/fsharp/federation/Limen.Federation.Target.Wasm/publish
scripts.test:site:fsharp: dotnet run --project site/fsharp/tests/Limen.Site.Engine.Tests/Limen.Site.Engine.Tests.fsproj -c Release && dotnet run --project site/fsharp/federation/tests/Limen.Federation.Proof.Tests/Limen.Federation.Proof.Tests.fsproj -c Release
